svg.title: Atomic cross sections of the F10, R10, F15 and R15 Au–MoS₂ structures
svg.desc: True x–z projections of all source atoms, viewed along the periodic wire direction y. All four structures use one common physical scale. Actual Au widths are 1.106, 0.902, 1.506 and 1.317 nm. The 10 and 15 names are labels, not literal nanometre dimensions. No illustrative atoms or bonds are added.

g.text: Atomic cross sections · same physical scale
